stages.name: IEC Submission
stages.gateRule: IEC approval ke bina protocol aage nahi badhega.

stages.name: IEC Approval
stages.gateRule: Approval letter attach karna zaroori hai.

stages.name: CTRI Registration
stages.gateRule: Prospective rule — first patient enrol hone se PEHLE CTRI number.

stages.name: Recruitment
stages.gateRule: Informed consent ke bina participant enrol nahi hoga.

stages.name: Database Lock
stages.gateRule: Safety + data quality clear hone tak DB lock nahi hoga.

hardGateRules: IEC approval ke bina protocol aage nahi badhega.
CTRI number ke bina Enrolment module LOCK.
Informed consent ke bina participant enrol nahi hoga.
SAE 24 ghante ke andar report nahi hui to case URGENT.
MedDRA coding (PT + SOC) ke bina case regulator ke paas nahi jaayega.
Protocol deviation ka CAPA bharne tak site pe naya patient enroll nahi.
Har change immutable ALCOA+ audit trail me hash ke saath — DELETE nahi.
